posts.title: The Untrainable Edge in the AI Era
posts.content: Abilities that can be publicly benchmarked will keep being compressed by AI. Long-term value moves toward harder-to-train territory: self-generated traits, judgment, real-world permission, repeated good judgment, and the right to define what Good means.

posts.title: What Big Tech Fears Most About AI Disruption
posts.content: AI reprices the structure of advantage: entry points, resource advantages, talent barriers, and organizational speed. The dangerous shift is not one feature being replaced; it is users expressing intent to AI first while incumbent products move into the execution layer.
